reason: I buy my makeup from brands I know, at Ulta or the counter where I can try it on. A $36 balm from a website I've never heard of, with no reviews, from a Facebook ad? I'd scroll right past it.
objection: Nobody has tried it yet, and every balm that promised to keep my lips moist ended up drying them out. Thirty-six dollars is a lot for something I can't test first, from a company I can't walk into.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it at Ulta or Sephora where I could try it, or my granddaughter showing me real women my age using it on TikTok and saying it doesn't dry them out.
